event.intro_lead:
Two events run during the festival.
Your ticket is a raffle entry, and the leaflet is a stamp card.
event.ticket_summary: Staff hand out entry slips in front of the screening hall. Tear it in half: drop one half in the box and keep the other. Five Baemin gift card winners are drawn at the closing ceremony.
event.ticket_step_1: Get an entry slip from staff at the hall
event.ticket_step_2: Tear it in half along the line
event.ticket_step_3: Drop one half in the box, keep the other
event.ticket_more: One entry slip per screening. More films, more chances! 🍀
event.ticket_draw: Draw: numbers are called live at the closing ceremony, Fri 11/20. Hold the matching half to win!
event.ticket_attend: Prizes go on the spot to winners holding the matching half. If no one answers, we draw again. Keep your half until the closing ceremony.
event.stamp_summary: One stamp per screening session on your leaflet. There are 6 sessions, and gifts stack as you collect.
event.stamp_step_1: Pick up a leaflet at the info desk
event.stamp_step_2: Watch a film, stamp in any color
event.stamp_all: Gifts stack! Fill 5 and take home all three ✨
event.stamp_where: Claim gifts in front of the screening hall
event.stamp_rule: One stamp per session. Claimed gifts are checked on your leaflet.
event.cta_text: Which film will you start with?
event.ticket_staff: Handed out by staff at the hall
event.stamp_bonus: The 6th slot is a bonus! Watch all 6 sessions to fill the whole leaflet.
